title: 复盘星巴克 2025-01-17 内部信：怎样说明总部调整
topic: 依据星巴克 CEO 2025 年 1 月内部信，解释支持团队调整、不受影响的团队及沟通时间

source.title: Back to Starbucks: Transforming our support organization
source.section: 星巴克 CEO 致员工公开信
source.type: 星巴克 CEO 致员工公开信
source.context: 星巴克如何调整总部团队，同时保障门店服务？
paragraphs: We need to meaningfully change how our support teams are organized and how we work, making sure that we have the capacity and capabilities to deliver on Back to Starbucks, and are prioritizing the areas that have the biggest impact on the experience in our stores.

We have recently begun the work to define the support organization for the future. We are approaching this work thoughtfully, but it will involve difficult decisions and choices. I expect that, unfortunately, we will have job eliminations and smaller support teams moving forward. This work will not affect our in-store teams or the investments we are making in store hours.

We will communicate changes by early March. I do not take these decisions lightly, and I appreciate that this will create uncertainty and concern between now and then. I wanted to be transparent about our progress and our plans and ensure that you hear about this work directly from me.
translations: 我们需要切实调整支持团队的组织方式和工作方式，确保团队具备落实“重返星巴克”计划的能力，并优先处理对门店体验影响最大的工作。
公司正在设计未来的支持组织，这会涉及艰难的决定。预计会减少一些岗位并缩小支持团队，但门店团队和门店工时投入不会受到影响。
公司会在三月初前沟通变化。CEO 表示，他理解这段时间的不确定和担忧，希望员工直接从他这里了解进展与计划。
fullTextParagraphs: In September, we outlined our plan to revitalize Starbucks by focusing on what has always set us apart: a welcoming coffeehouse where people gather and where we serve the finest coffee, handcrafted by our skilled baristas.

Since then, we have been enhancing the in-store experience with the return of the condiment bar, writing on cups, more ceramic mugs and a revised code of conduct. We’ve shifted our marketing from discounts to highlighting our brand story and coffee leadership. We’ve taken steps on pricing transparency by removing the non-dairy milk upcharge. We’ve set a goal of a four-minute wait time in cafés and have provided additional coverage hours in over 3,000 stores. We’ve doubled paid parental leave for our U.S. retail teams and aim to promote internally for 90% of retail leadership roles in three years.
We have much more work to do but I’m pleased with the progress we’ve made and appreciate how everyone has rallied around the plan.

Our initial work has — rightly — focused on our U.S. and Canada stores and the store experience. However, as we look to transform our business globally, we also need to examine the role, structure and size of our support teams around the world.

Across our support teams, we have many talented partners with deep expertise and a strong, skilled team that is driving impact for our customers, partners and business every day. As I’ve spent time working with teams across the business and observed how we work, it’s also clear that we have some opportunities to operate more efficiently. Additional opportunities include:
Increased ownership and accountability: We need to ensure all our work has a clear owner, who can make decisions, and who is accountable for achieving the goals. This will help us move faster.
Clear priorities and reduced complexity: Our “Back to Starbucks” plan is the priority, and we need to stay focused, reduce complexity and remove conflicting goals.

Better integration: We need to reduce silos and duplication of effort. Our size and structure can slow us down, with too many layers, managers of small teams and roles focused primarily on coordinating work.

We need to meaningfully change how our support teams are organized and how we work, making sure that we have the capacity and capabilities to deliver on Back to Starbucks, and are prioritizing the areas that have the biggest impact on the experience in our stores.

We have recently begun the work to define the support organization for the future. We are approaching this work thoughtfully, but it will involve difficult decisions and choices. I expect that, unfortunately, we will have job eliminations and smaller support teams moving forward. This work will not affect our in-store teams or the investments we are making in store hours.

We will communicate changes by early March. I do not take these decisions lightly, and I appreciate that this will create uncertainty and concern between now and then. I wanted to be transparent about our progress and our plans and ensure that you hear about this work directly from me.
Thank you for all you are doing.

notes.phrase: We need to meaningfully change how our support teams are organized and how we work
notes.meaning: 我们需要切实调整支持团队的组织方式和工作方式
notes.explain: meaningfully 表示变化要有实际作用；how 引导调整的具体方面。
notes.example: We need to change how the team is organized and how decisions are made.

notes.phrase: prioritizing the areas that have the biggest impact on the experience in our stores
notes.meaning: 优先处理对门店体验影响最大的领域
notes.explain: prioritize the areas that... 用于说明取舍的依据和先后顺序。
notes.example: We are prioritizing the changes that have the biggest impact on customers.

notes.phrase: We will communicate changes by early March.
notes.meaning: 我们会在三月初前沟通变化。
notes.explain: by + 时间表示不晚于该时间；沟通承诺应写明时间范围。
notes.example: We will communicate the updated schedule by Friday.

scenario.title: 练习情境（虚构）：向支持团队说明组织变化
english: A retail company is changing its support structure to help stores spend more time with customers.
Some headquarters roles will be combined, while store teams and scheduled store hours will stay in place.
Leadership plans to share individual decisions by March 10. Write three sentences for the support team.
chinese: 一家零售公司正在调整支持团队结构，让门店能把更多时间用在顾客身上。
总部的部分岗位将合并，门店团队和排定的门店工时会保留。
管理层计划在 3 月 10 日前逐一沟通具体安排。请给支持团队写三句话。

firstAttempt.prompt: 给支持团队写三句话：复盘星巴克 CEO 于 2025 年 1 月 17 日的内部信，说明门店体验优先级、总部支持团队调整方向和影响范围，再报告当时承诺的沟通时间。
firstAttempt.sample: In his January 17, 2025 message, Starbucks’ CEO said the company was redesigning support teams to focus on work with the greatest impact on stores. He expected some job eliminations and smaller support teams, while in-store teams and planned store-hour investments would not be affected. The message said changes would be communicated by early March 2025.
firstAttempt.rationale: 这是对 2025 年 1 月内部信的历史复盘：将岗位调整写成当时的预期，并把三月初的沟通承诺限定在 2025 年。

structure.original: We will communicate changes by early March.
analysis: will communicate 表示接下来会采取的沟通行动。
by early March 承诺的是最迟时间，能帮助员工知道何时获得更新。
structure.transfer: We will share the updated reporting lines by Friday.

rewrite.bad: Some changes are coming, and we will tell you more later.
rewrite.good: In his January 17, 2025 message, Starbucks’ CEO said the company was redesigning support teams to focus on work with the greatest impact on stores. He expected some job eliminations and smaller support teams, while in-store teams and planned store-hour investments would not be affected. The message said changes would be communicated by early March 2025.
rewrite.translation: 星巴克 CEO 在 2025 年 1 月 17 日的内部信中表示，公司正在重新设计支持团队，把重点放在对门店影响最大的工作上。他预计会裁减一些岗位并缩小支持团队规模，但门店团队和计划中的门店工时投入不会受到影响。信中说，公司将在 2025 年 3 月初前沟通变化。
rewrite.pattern: [attribute and date the message] → [state expected changes and exclusions] → [report the promised update date]

choice.prompt: 员工需要知道门店团队不受影响，并且何时会得到下一次更新。哪句话最明确？
options: We are making changes to help the business move faster.
Some teams may be affected, and we will share more details later.
Support teams will change, store teams will remain in place, and we will share individual updates by March 10.
choice.why: 第三句说明变化范围、不受影响的团队和明确的沟通时间。

output.prompt: 练习迁移（虚构消费品公司）：一家消费品公司正在合并两个总部支持小组，让客户服务团队能更快处理门店问题。门店员工和排班不受影响，个人岗位安排将在 4 月 15 日前告知。请给员工写三句话，说明优先目标、变化范围和沟通时间。
output.sample: Our priority is to help customer-service teams resolve store issues faster. We are combining two headquarters support groups; store employees and schedules will not be affected. We will communicate individual role decisions by April 15.
check: 说明组织调整要支持的业务目标
区分总部变化和不受影响的门店团队
写出个人安排的沟通时间
